rv.q: The Trap Door Theatre has outdone itself with “Nana,” a jewel in its 30th season celebration.
Trap Door's talented ensemble tells the story with such fun and gusto, with such rich color and music, that it vibrates—this show is alive.
Miguel Long and Nicole Weisner direct this highly physical, comic production.
Nana really does provide her audiences with a night of excitement.

cn.t: Trap Door Theatre's visually spectacular production of Zola's "Nana" proves a sure-fire hit, with critics praising the elaborate period design and choreography in this tale of a 19th century courtesan's rise and fall.
